summary.text: Andy Zahn is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 20-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Peter Abbarno.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as freelance writer.

paragraphs.text: Andy Zahn is, according to his Ballotpedia survey answers, a lifelong resident of Toutle, Washington, where he grew up on a small farm near Mt. St. Helens.

The survey says he attended Lower Columbia College and has held jobs ranging from hauling hay to stewarding public lands, photography and writing for publications such as Digital Trends, Android Police and SlashGear.
Zahn described himself as an outdoorsman and an advocate for conservation and outdoor access for rural residents.
He said he wants legislation to address conflicts among industry, agriculture and the environment in rural communities.
